classes: writes
methylates the site: an IntAct methylation reaction with the partner as the enzyme and the methylarginine curated at the site, or mutating the site changes the reaction
removes
demethylates the site: an IntAct demethylation reaction with the partner as the enzyme and the methylarginine curated at the site
binds_methylated
binds with the site methylated in the experiment: a PDB structure modelling a methylarginine there (2MR, DA2 or NMM), or an IntAct binding record that curates the residue as methylated
binds_unmodified
binds with an unmodified arginine at the site: a PDB structure modelling ARG there
binds_other_residue
binds with another residue at the site: a PDB structure of a mutated or variant construct (state_detail names it)
binds_state_not_read
a PDB interface at the site whose residue there could not be read (no entity of the entry aligns to the site)
mutation_changes_binding
mutating the site decreases, disrupts or increases the binding (IntAct)
mutation_no_effect
mutating the site leaves the binding unchanged (IntAct)
mutation_unspecified
a mutation of the site was tested, its effect on the binding not stated (IntAct feature type mutation)
binds_region
binds a region holding the site, the state of the site not recorded (IntAct binding region)
other_reaction

an enzymatic reaction on a region holding the site that IntAct does not place at the site: acetylation, phosphorylation or cleavage, a methylation or demethylation of another residue (a lysine methyltransferase on a histone tail), one where mutating the site has no effect, or one in which the site's protein is the enzyme
nucleic_acid
RNA or DNA: contact in a PDB structure, a crosslink or RNA-bound peptide in cells, an IntAct nucleic-acid participant, or a UniProt DNA-binding region (annotation)
not_a_protein
the IntAct partner is not a protein: a gene locus (chromatin immunoprecipitation), a small molecule or another participant
self
another copy of the same protein in a PDB structure, or the protein with itself in IntAct
predicted
a predicted complex model only (ProtVar, AlphaFold DB), not an observation
states: dimethylarginine, asymmetric or symmetric not stated (PSI-MOD MOD:00783)
another residue in the construct (state_detail names it)
mutated in the experiment (state_detail gives the change)
a structure whose residue at the site could not be read
not recorded: an IntAct region, or a crosslink, prediction or annotation
flags: the partner in the experiment is from another species (its PDB entity or IntAct participant)
the site's protein in the experiment is from another species: an orthologue identical around the site
the PDB entity is not aligned to this protein: its sequence around the site is identical (a peptide, an orthologue, or another histone variant sharing the tail)
the methylation the experiment records (mono- or dimethyl, asymmetric or symmetric) is not among the states the release reports at the site
the paper's title and abstract name other arginines by number and not this one (in UniProt or histone numbering): check that IntAct placed the feature on the residue the paper studied
the paper's title names another member of the partner's gene family and not the partner (IntAct records): check which protein the paper studied
a methylation reaction whose product is not the kind the enzyme's PRMT type makes (type I asymmetric, type II symmetric, type III monomethyl only)
the record gives no PubMed or DOI
IntAct records the interaction as not observed
